facts.value: Go to Professional Education Programmes, choose the programme of your choice, read ‘Entry Requirements’ for required documents, click the Apply button, create a username and password, upload required documents, pay an application fee of €50, and submit your application.
Applicants must upload their educational documents. UL graduates do not need to upload UL Transcripts.
The application fee allows you to apply for two postgraduate programmes in one online application.
If you experience difficulties creating an account, check the type of browser you are using - Google Chrome can cause problems in some instances.
If you experience any difficulty with your application, please contact us.
